text:
## Escalation Reporting  
**Monthly Escalation Report:**
- Total escalations by level
- Average resolution time
- Common escalation reasons
- Systemic issues identified
- Trend analysis  
**Quarterly Review:**
- Board Risk Committee notified of Level 5 escalations
- Audit committee notified of regulatory escalations
- Trends discussed, process improvements considered

raw_entities.name: Escalation Reporting Process
raw_entities.description: A formal reporting and review procedure that captures escalation metrics monthly and conducts quarterly reviews with governance committees. The process tracks escalation volumes by level, resolution times, root causes, and systemic issues to identify trends and drive process improvements.
context: Board Risk Committee notified of Level 5 escalations
Audit committee notified of regulatory escalations

raw_entities.name: Monthly Escalation Report Compilation
raw_entities.description: A monthly data collection and reporting step that aggregates escalation metrics including total count by level, average resolution time, common reasons for escalation, identified systemic issues, and trend analysis.

raw_entities.name: Quarterly Escalation Review
raw_entities.description: A quarterly governance review step where escalation trends are discussed with relevant committees, regulatory escalations are reported to audit oversight, and process improvements are considered based on identified patterns.
context: Board Risk Committee notified of Level 5 escalations
Audit committee notified of regulatory escalations

raw_entities.description: The governance body responsible for receiving notification of regulatory escalations and participating in the quarterly review of escalation trends and process improvements.
